_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (Week 45). Written from that week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: Sales slipped 3.1% to £2,403 on 97 units. The Essential Kit fell to £656 from £805, while the 16oz Solution (£329), Repel (£201) and Refresh Kit (£194) all grew.

Ad spend rose 15% to £945 but ad sales fell 27% to £1,137, so ACoS jumped from 52.7% to 83.2%. Most of the extra cost is one keyword: “suede shoe cleaner” (broad, £22 bid) spent £187 for one £17 order.
refunds_title: Refunds up from a low base
refunds: Refunds were £69 on 5 units (5.3% refund rate) vs £28 on 2 units last week. Three of the five were the 8oz Cleaning Solution (£23).
pacing_reco: November is £2,727 through Nov 8 (£341 a day), on pace for about £10.2K vs £11.3K in October. The quickest lever is the suede keyword: £187 of this week's spend brought one £17 order.
ads_context: TACoS rose from 33.1% to 39.4%; sales slowed through the week while spend did not.
Saturday and Sunday ads cost more than they brought in (£261 spend for £214 in ad sales).
ads_strategy: Branded keywords cost £60 for £178 in sales and 7 orders (33.9% ACoS).
Category keywords cost £531 for £494 in sales (107% ACoS); 54 campaigns spent £228 with no sales.
bid_moves: Cut the £22 bid on “suede shoe cleaner” (broad): £187 spent for 1 order.
Negate “crep protect spray” (£32, 22 clicks) and “shoe trees for men” (£18, 14 clicks): no orders.
Add “reshoev8r brushes” as an exact keyword: £5 for £53 and 2 orders.
coupons: Coupons are still behind about half of all orders.
promotions: This week: 11 promotion orders, £71 in promotional discounts (vs 25 orders and £102 last week).
Fewer promotion orders this week, with no matching lift in sales.
